proof_scope: In progress. R1788 establishes nonconcentration at the rational separation scale for the actual symmetric generator walk. For m freely generating matrices and any k>=1 with k^2<=2m, every n-step endpoint has probability <=(2/k)^n. The proof uses a radial free-group supersolution and an exact identification with the actual matrix-walk singleton measure. For rational generators with common denominator Q, every endpoint has denominator Q^n. If eta>0, eta<=1 and 8*eta<Q^(-2n), a right-smoothing ball meets at most one possible endpoint. Consequently the actual smoothed density is bounded by (2/k)^n/H(B_eta). For the R1787 family, m>=epsilon^(-3) gives the factor (2*epsilon)^n. When eta<=1/2, both the pointwise density and its squared L2 integral are bounded by 512*(2*epsilon)^n/(c_H*eta^3). Integrability of the real density squared is proved. This is an initial estimate, not the much stronger full walk-flatness bound.
